gas = mixture of methane with the second hydrocarbon; builder must use column 'HC phase water-free methane content' as the gas-phase composition (y_CH4 = printed/100 on water-free basis)
notes: Block label rows are the stacked side-by-side pressure blocks. Dash cells are kept as '-'.
